tasks.title: Centralize frontend API base URL configuration and eliminate hardcoded localhost addresses
tasks.context: The frontend currently hardcodes 'http://localhost:5001/api/v1' in auth.service.ts, AppContext.tsx, and ResultsPage.tsx. Vite's config already defines a development proxy forwarding '/api' to 'http://localhost:5001'. Hardcoded localhost breaks staging and production builds.
tasks.description: Inspect all existing fetch calls in src/services/auth/auth.service.ts, src/context/AppContext.tsx, and src/pages/ResultsPage.tsx. Create a new configuration file 'src/config/api.ts' exporting 'export const API_BASE = import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '/api/v1';'. Replace all hardcoded 'http://localhost:5001/api/v1' occurrences in those 3 files with the imported 'API_BASE'. Do NOT change any request headers, bodies, or response handling.
acceptance_criteria: A grep search for 'http://localhost:5001' across the 'src/' directory returns 0 occurrences.
The new 'src/config/api.ts' exports 'API_BASE' with fallback to '/api/v1'.
All authentication, scan initiation, project fetching, report history, and PDF export requests use 'API_BASE'.
Running 'npm run build' compiles without any TypeScript or bundling errors.
Running 'npm run lint' passes with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
tasks.commit_message: refactor(client): centralize API base URL and eliminate hardcoded localhost [Ralph TASK-003]

tasks.title: Implement automated retention cleanup for temporary Puppeteer screenshots
tasks.context: Puppeteer captures full-page and viewport screenshots to server/temp/ during scans. Currently there is no retention policy, causing screenshot files to accumulate indefinitely on disk.
tasks.description: Inspect server/services/puppeteer/screenshots.ts. Add an asynchronous, non-blocking helper 'cleanOldScreenshots(maxAgeMs = 3600000)' that reads server/temp/, checks modification times, and removes 'screenshot_*.png' files older than 1 hour. Trigger this helper asynchronously inside 'captureScreenshots' without awaiting it or blocking the screenshot return, catching and silently suppressing any file access errors.
acceptance_criteria: Screenshots are still captured and returned in the exact existing format ('{ fullPagePath, viewportPath }').
Screenshot files older than 1 hour in server/temp/ are safely unlinked.
If cleanup fails due to locked files or missing directory, no exception is thrown to callers.
Running 'npm test' passes all 75 server tests.
Running 'npm run lint' passes with 0 warnings.
tasks.commit_message: feat(crawler): add non-blocking retention cleanup for temp screenshots [Ralph TASK-005]

tasks.title: Add dedicated rate limiting protection for heavy website scan endpoint
tasks.context: The scan endpoint POST /api/v1/analysis/scan spawns resource-heavy Puppeteer Chrome instances, but currently shares the global API rate limit (100 requests per 15 minutes) with lightweight read endpoints.
tasks.description: Inspect server/middlewares/rateLimiter.ts and server/routes/analysisRoutes.ts. In rateLimiter.ts, define and export 'scanLimiter = rateLimit({ windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000, max: 20, standardHeaders: true, legacyHeaders: false, message: { success: false, message: 'Too many analysis scans requested from this IP. Please try again after 15 minutes.' } })'. In analysisRoutes.ts, apply 'scanLimiter' specifically to the 'router.post('/scan', ...)' route. Leave general routes under the existing apiLimiter.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/v1/analysis/scan uses 'scanLimiter' (20 scans per 15 min window per IP).
Other endpoints in server continue to use standard limits without disruption.
When the limit is reached, a 429 status code with the specified JSON error response is returned.
Running 'npm test' passes all 75 server tests.
Running 'npm run lint' passes with 0 warnings.
tasks.commit_message: feat(security): add dedicated rate limiting for analysis scan endpoint [Ralph TASK-006]
